crawl:
#!@STORE@
set -euo pipefail
export REDIS_PASSWORD="$(</home/alice/.local/state/ivm-services/credentials/redis-password)"
export REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD"
ready=0
for _ in {1..60}; do
  if @STORE@ -h 127.0.0.1 -p 16379 ping | @STORE@ -qx PONG; then ready=1; break; fi
  @STORE@ 1
done
test "$ready" = 1
export CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN="$(</run/secrets/crawl4ai-api-token)"
test -n "$CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN"
export REDIS_HOST=127.0.0.1 REDIS_PORT=16379
export CRAWL4AI_ARTIFACT_DIR=/home/alice/.local/state/ivm-services/crawl4ai/outputs
export HOME=/home/alice/.local/state/ivm-services/crawl4ai/home CRAWL4_AI_BASE_DIRECTORY=/home/alice/.local/state/ivm-services/crawl4ai/home
export XDG_CACHE_HOME=/home/alice/.local/state/ivm-services/crawl4ai/cache
export GUNICORN_BIND=127.0.0.1:11235
export CRAWL4AI_HOOKS_ENABLED=false CRAWL4AI_EXECUTE_JS_ENABLED=false
exec @STORE@
postgres:
#!@STORE@
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
if [ ! -e /home/alice/.local/state/ivm-services/postgres/PG_VERSION ]; then
  @STORE@ -D /home/alice/.local/state/ivm-services/postgres --auth-local=peer --auth-host=reject --encoding=UTF8 --locale=C.UTF-8
fi
test "$(</home/alice/.local/state/ivm-services/postgres/PG_VERSION)" = 18
exec @STORE@ -D /home/alice/.local/state/ivm-services/postgres -k /home/alice/.local/state/ivm-services/postgres-socket -c listen_addresses= -c unix_socket_permissions=0700
